newsitem.title: DUBAI: SABIC unit awards olefins project contract.
newsitem.headline: SABIC unit awards olefins project contract.

text.p: Saudi state-owned Arabian Petrochemical Co (Petrokemya) on Wednesday awarded Dutch-based Kinetics Technology International (KTI) and Technip Saudi Arabia Ltd, a unit of French Technip, a contract to install furnaces for its Olefins-III expansion project.
The Olefins-III project involves the construction of a 800,000 tonnes a year flexible feedstock ethylene plant at the Saudi industrial city of Jubail by the year 2000.
"Today's contract is the first for the supply of long-term critical equipment for the project," a company statement said.
KTI will be in charge of offshore work including engineering and design and Technip will build and install the furnaces.
Petrokemya, a wholly owned affiliate of majority state-owned Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC), has a annual petrochemical output capacity of 2.3 million tonnes.
No value for the contract was given.
